paragraphs.label: Mở thư và xin lỗi
paragraphs.text:
Dear Ms Brown,

I am writing to apologise for forgetting to confirm my attendance in connection with a student employment workshop. I understand that this caused inconvenience, and I take responsibility for not informing you sooner.
paragraphs.noteVi: Nhận lỗi trực tiếp và đúng sự việc.

. I understand that this caused inconvenience, and I take responsibility for not informing you sooner.

paragraphs.template:
Dear [danh xưng và họ người nhận],

I am writing to apologise for [lỗi cần xin lỗi — V-ing] in connection with [sự kiện / hoạt động]. I understand that this caused inconvenience, and I take responsibility for not informing you sooner.

paragraphs.label: Giải thích
paragraphs.text: The reason was that I mistakenly thought my reply had been sent. However, I recognise that I should have checked the arrangements and contacted you earlier. Please be assured that I do not take your time or assistance for granted.

paragraphs.label: Khắc phục
paragraphs.text: To put matters right, I would like to arrive early at the next session and help prepare the materials. paragraphs.text:
Thank you for your time and consideration. Please let me know if you require any further information. I look forward to hearing from you.

Yours sincerely,
Minh Nguyen
